title: Spinning top with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- handle/axis on top -->
  <rect x="47" y="14" width="6" height="14" rx="2" fill="#c084fc"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="13" r="5" fill="#a855f7"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="13" r="2.5" fill="#e9d5ff"/>

  <!-- main body - upper cone -->
  <path d="M50 26 L30 58 Q50 66 70 58 Z" fill="#f87171"/>

  <!-- body stripes -->
  <path d="M33 52 Q50 62 67 52 L64 58 Q50 68 36 58 Z" fill="#fbbf24"/>
  <path d="M50 26 L30 58 Q50 66 70 58 Z" fill="none" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- middle band -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="22" ry="7" fill="#fbbf24"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="60" rx="22" ry="7" fill="none" stroke="#d97706" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- lower body - bottom cone -->
  <path d="M28 62 Q50 72 72 62 L54 86 Q50 90 46 86 Z" fill="#34d399"/>

  <!-- bottom tip -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="88" r="4" fill="#059669"/>

  <!-- smiling face on upper cone -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="43" cy="42" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#1e3a5f"/>
  <ellipse cx="57" cy="42" rx="3" ry="4" fill="#1e3a5f"/>
  <!-- eye shine -->
  <circle cx="44" cy="40.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="40.5" r="1.2" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M42 49 Q50 57 58 49" fill="none" stroke="#1e3a5f" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="38" cy="47" r="3" fill="#fca5a5" opacity="0.8"/>
  <circle cx="62" cy="47" r="3" fill="#fca5a5" opacity="0.8"/>

  <!-- motion swirls -->
  <path d="M18 70 Q10 63 16 56" fill="none" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M82 70 Q90 63 84 56" fill="none" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M22 78 Q12 74 14 65" fill="none" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M78 78 Q88 74 86 65" fill="none" stroke="#93c5fd" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
